summary: Exception-frame dispatch helper for a structured-exception handler. Inspects ExceptionRecord->ExceptionFlags for the unwinding bitmask 0x66; on an unwind pass it sets TargetFrame[9] to 1 and returns 1 (continue unwind). On the normal path it invokes the per-frame cleanup handler sub_593446, then SEHUnwindHandler if TargetFrame[9] was not set by that handler, and finally calls the stored continuation at TargetFrame[6] and returns its result.

operations.description: Test ExceptionRecord->ExceptionFlags against the unwind bitmask 0x66; nonzero selects the unwind path.
On the unwind path set TargetFrame[9] to 1 to record that unwinding is in progress.
Return 1 to continue the unwind pass.
On the normal path call sub_593446(ExceptionRecord, TargetFrame[3], a4, 0, TargetFrame[2], TargetFrame[4], TargetFrame[5], 1) as the per-frame handler.
If TargetFrame[9] is still 0 after the handler call, invoke SEHUnwindHandler(a1, TargetFrame, ExceptionRecord).
Call the continuation function pointer stored at TargetFrame[6].
